blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Resigning from the country’s second-highest post never crossed Vice President Sara Duterte’s mind, her spokesperson said Tuesday. Duterte’s spokesperson lawyer Salvador Paolo Panelo Jr. said he has asked Duterte about the matter twice, with the vice president saying it was not an option. “Such a thought never crossed her mind. She never considered anything like that, especially because the people elected her to serve as vice president,” Panelo said. “And if they want to remove her from office, then let them do it, so the people can see through this impeachment that the charges against her have no […]...
